2.163.1
GaugePanel.Name
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The GaugePanel.Name attribute specifies a unique identifier for a GaugePanel. The
GaugePanel.Name attribute MUST be specified. The value of this attribute MUST be a case-sensitive
CLS-compliant identifier [UTR15] that is unique for all the report items within a Report.
The following is the parent element of the GaugePanel.Name attribute.
Parent elements
GaugePanel
The following is the XML Schema definition of the GaugePanel.Name attribute.
 <xsd:attribute name="Name" type="xsd:normalizedString" use="required" />
